# AI Customer Support Bot (SAV E-Commerce AI)

## Reference Mission (Malt)
- **Title:** Développeur / Expert AI - Agent Support Client E-Commerce Intelligent
- **Platform:** Malt / Freelance
- **Estimated Price Range / TJM:** 500€ - 750€ / jour (Projet au forfait ~3,500€ - 5,000€)

## Features
- Real-time customer support query resolution with instant intent classification
- Pre-indexed knowledge base query engine with zero lag
- High-performance memoized intent matching and response caching
- Interactive fallback handling for human agent escalation

## Performance Optimizations
- **Memoized Lookup Index:** Stores pre-tokenized target intent vectors to avoid costly regex rebuilds on every incoming keystroke/message.
- **Micro-batch DOM updates:** Batches simulated streaming output using requestAnimationFrame.
